attributes.title: PPA2027 Annual Convention
attributes.summary:
The Pennsylvania Psychological Association holds PPA2027 at the Pittsburgh Airport Marriott, from Wednesday, June 16 to Saturday, June 19, 2027. The theme is "Single Impact, Infinite Echo," about how small clinical moments can lead to wider change. Hotel rooms can already be reserved, but registration has not opened yet.

PPA says attendees can earn up to 30 CE credits. These include the mandatory Pennsylvania topics: Act 31 child abuse recognition and reporting, suicide prevention and ethics. School psychologists receive Act 48 credit, and members get a significant discount. The fees and the session program are not published yet. The exhibitor registration page lists the exhibit dates as June 16 to 18, 2027.
